question: Is there a group study room free at Shannon from 5pm to 8pm tomorrow?

content.text: What kinds of spaces can I reserve at Shannon?

At Shannon Library, you can reserve:

*Group Study Rooms*
Default booking time is 1 hour, but you can extend up to 3 hours total using the dropdown after selecting a start time.

You can browse and book available rooms here: <https://cal.lib.virginia.edu/spaces?lid=1076|Shannon Library Space Booking>

Want me to check which specific rooms are free at a particular time today or another day?

*Georges Student Center* (Clemons Library, 2nd Floor) has *no free slots* today, Thursday, July 30, 2026, across all 15 reservable rooms:

*Conference Rooms:*
• Clemons 202, 203, 204 — all fully booked

*Group Study Rooms:*
• Clemons 220, 221, 222, 224, 226, 227, 230, 234, 237, 238, 241, 245 — all fully booked

You can check the live booking calendar in case of last-minute cancellations here: <https://cal.lib.virginia.edu/spaces?lid=2172|Georges Student Center Booking>

Would you like me to check availability for tomorrow or a different location?
